decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-1a97b17bde3d] names the subject exactly: the metric `cilium_identity_cache_timer_trigger_latency`. It appears under the 1.17 upgrade notes' "Added Metrics" section, so the change is an addition. The surrounding section ([ev-8a664283f86e], [ev-1b1b9343e346]) lists related identity-cache timer metrics as additions too. No condition or consequence is stated, so the change is an unconditional, purely informational new metric. The open subject and applicability aspects come from having no subject family for metrics, not from vague evidence. The evidence does not say what the metric measures, but that is not needed to type an added metric.
